summary: Frontend testing completed for AriOme app. All major features working correctly: Explore tab loads with 46 content items (24 wisdom + 22 practices), video player plays in-app via YouTube iframe, audio player uses HTML5 audio element, mood filtering works, subscription page loads (no 404), circles page loads with intention filters and join buttons, journal page loads with sign-in prompt for unauthenticated users.

minor.issue: Some audio URLs return 403 Forbidden - audio files may not be accessible

integration_issues.issue: Multiple 404 errors for thumbnail images - some images may not load

action_items: Verify audio file URLs are valid and accessible (currently returning 403)
Check thumbnail image URLs - multiple 404 errors observed
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major features tested and working. Login flow works with test@ariome.com/test1234. Content loads correctly with 46 items total. Video plays in-app via iframe, audio uses HTML5 element. Subscription page at /subscription works. Circles page loads with filters and join buttons. Journal requires authentication.
